text:
Alex: quick check — planning to cut v2.7.0 tomorrow at 17:00 PST. Can we do a final sweep of changelog entries + examples? I want to make sure we have at least one example per user-facing change.

Maya: @Alex +1, i'll do a quick pass. Can you confirm cutoff time and whether we accept minor doc-only patches after cutoff?

Alex: cutoff is 17:00 but doc-only fixes can go until 18:00 as long as they are tiny. anything code-affecting must be merged before cutoff.

ReleaseBot: Automated reminder: Release v2.7.0 scheduled for 2025-03-18 17:00 PST. See release checklist: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.7.0/checklist

Jorge: quick question — for backports: do we tag backport PRs with `backport/2.7` and add the `release/backport` label? i've got one bugfix that needs cherrypick.

Sam: yep, add `backport/2.7` to the branch name and `release/backport` label. also ping me for queue ordering if it's high priority.

Maya: example style note: keep it short, show input -> expected snippet, and mention any model/config changes. e.g.

```
- Improved tokenization fallback for bad utf input
  Example:
  Input: "\uFFFDabc"
  Output: fallback -> normalized string
  Component: runtime/tokenizer
```

Li: tiny formatting nit: please include `Component:` tag and size tag (`minor/major/doc`) in frontmatter for automation to categorize. otherwise entries get misclassified.

Alex: good call. let's use this shape as required. i'll post a template in the PR description.

Maya: putting together a short lint script you can run locally: `scripts/validate_changelog.sh` — it checks presence of Component and size and validates bullet shape. will open a tiny PR.

Sam: FYI the version bump pipeline runs on merge to `main` but we still need the manual `bump-version` tag on the release PR to avoid accidental roll-forward.

Jorge: for branch coordination: i propose we freeze `release/queue` and only allow backports + docs there. put all other release-ready PRs into `release/pending` and i'll run a serial merge. Thoughts?

Maya: that works. can we add a note in the release channel so PMs know the status?

Alex: yes — i'll post an update after the first merge.

ReleaseBot: Heads up: changelog linter job has passed for current PRs (2 warnings). Run details: https://ci.redwood/reports/changelog-lint/1912345

Li: i'll address the warnings (missing Component tag) now.

Sam: once lint is green i'll reorder the queue and DM assignees about expected merge window.

Alex: thanks all — final ask: if you haven't added an example, please do it by 15:30 PST so Maya has time to review. small entries are fine as long as they follow the `Component` + `size` rule. :thumbsup:

Maya: noted — ping me in-thread if you need a quick example pair.

Jorge: done — opened backport PR and added labels. CC @Sam

Li: fixed two entries, pushed. :sparkles:

Sam: queued and reordered — will DM owners in 10.

Alex: closing loop, thanks everyone.
